basic_details.job_title: District Health Society Kallakurichi Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 17 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Health Society, Kallakurichi (Maavatta Nalavaazhvu Sangam, Kallakurichi Maavattam) is filling 17 Staff Nurse posts on a purely temporary contract basis under the National Health Mission. The posts are in the Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (CEmONC) centres, including SNCU and PICU, and pay a consolidated Rs. 21,000 per month. Candidates with GNM or B.Sc Nursing, registered with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council, may submit the application form in person or by speed post from 21 November 2026; it must reach the District Health Office by 04 December 2026, 5.00 PM.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the Kallakurichi district website, https://kallakurichi.nic.in/.
Fill in the application form completely.
Attach copies of the documents listed below.

Hand in the application in person between 10.00 AM and 5.00 PM, or send it by speed post to: Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Office, (District Health Society), Peruvangur Road, Kallakurichi 606 213.
The application must reach the office by 04 December 2026, 5.00 PM.
The notice also gives the email address [email protected], but it does not ask for applications by email.
Date of birth proof: birth certificate, SSLC (10th) mark sheet or HSC (12th) mark sheet.
Educational certificates and mark lists: 10th, 12th, Diploma or B.Sc. certificate and mark lists.
Registration certificate of the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.
Tamil proficiency proof: 10th or 12th mark sheet showing Tamil studied as a subject.
Residence proof, any one of: Voter ID, Aadhar Card, Ration Card.

Conduct certificate from a Group A or Group B officer in government service. It must be recent, obtained within 3 months before the notification was published, and this applies to all applicants, including fresh graduates.
Other important special certificates from competent authorities, as mentioned in the selection criteria (if any).
important_instructions: Selected candidates must join immediately or on the date given in the Offer Letter. If a nurse is found guilty of serious misconduct or dereliction of duty, the District Health Society will remove the nurse immediately, without notice or compensation. Staying away from work for 15 continuous days without the prior permission of the competent authority is treated as abandoning the job and leads to automatic removal.

content_sections.heading: About Kallakurichi DHS Staff Nurse
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Kallakurichi works under the National Health Mission, and its Chairman is the District Collector of Kallakurichi. These Staff Nurse posts are in CEmONC centres, including the SNCU and PICU units. The centres are run under the control of the Director of Medical and Rural Health Services and the Director of Medical Education and Research. The posts are filled under the National Health Mission guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Registration with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council is mandatory. Knowledge of Tamil, the official language, is mandatory. Proof is the SSLC (10th) or HSC (12th) mark sheet showing Tamil studied as a subject. Age: not exceeding 50 years as on 20.11.2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. For the full eligibility conditions, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Diploma in Nursing (GNM) or B.Sc Nursing from a Government nursing college or a Government-recognised private nursing college, recognised by the State Government.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Staff Nurse gets a consolidated pay of Rs. 21,000/- per month. The notice does not mention HRA or any other allowance. The post is purely temporary and on contract under the National Health Mission guidelines. Under the NHM-TN contract rules, the selected nurse must serve at least 2 years in the post. The contract is renewed after every 11 months, based on a performance appraisal. A nurse who wants to resign must give 3 months' prior notice. Selected nurses must sign a declaration that the post is purely temporary and contractual, will not be regularised for any reason, and has no chance of becoming a permanent post.

content_sections.heading: Kallakurichi DHS Staff Nurse Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice does not list the duties. It says the duties and working hours will be fixed separately by the Mission Director, National Health Mission (State). This is done together with the Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, the Director of Medical and Rural Health Services, the Director of Medical Education and the Commissioner of Greater Chennai Corporation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kallakurichi DHS Staff Nurse
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the Kallakurichi district website, https://kallakurichi.nic.in/ . Fill in the application form completely. Attach copies of the documents listed below. Hand in the application in person between 10.00 AM and 5.00 PM, or send it by speed post to: Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Office, (District Health Society), Peruvangur Road, Kallakurichi 606 213. The application must reach the office by 04 December 2026, 5.00 PM. The notice also gives the email address [email protected] , but it does not ask for applications by email. Date of birth proof: birth certificate, SSLC (10th) mark sheet or HSC (12th) mark sheet. Educational certificates and mark lists: 10th, 12th, Diploma or B.Sc. certificate and mark lists. Registration certificate of the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council. Tamil proficiency proof: 10th or 12th mark sheet showing Tamil studied as a subject. Residence proof, any one of: Voter ID, Aadhar Card, Ration Card. Conduct certificate from a Group A or Group B officer in government service. It must be recent, obtained within 3 months before the notification was published, and this applies to all applicants, including fresh graduates. Other important special certificates from competent authorities, as mentioned in the selection criteria (if any).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The District Health Society has the right to call suitable applicants for certificate verification / interview. The notice does not give the date for this.

content_sections.text: Selected candidates must join immediately or on the date given in the Offer Letter. If a nurse is found guilty of serious misconduct or dereliction of duty, the District Health Society will remove the nurse immediately, without notice or compensation. Staying away from work for 15 continuous days without the prior permission of the competent authority is treated as abandoning the job and leads to automatic removal.

faq.question: Q1. How many Staff Nurse vacancies are in Kallakurichi DHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The District Health Society, Kallakurichi has notified 17 Staff Nurse posts on a contract / temporary basis under the National Health Mission.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the Kallakurichi DHS Staff Nurse application?
faq.answer: The application must reach the District Health Office, Kallakurichi by 04 December 2026, 5.00 PM. Applications are accepted from 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Kallakurichi DHS Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Diploma in Nursing (GNM) or B.Sc Nursing from a Government or Government-recognised private nursing college. Registration with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council and knowledge of Tamil are also mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Kallakurichi DHS Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 50 years as on 20.11.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Kallakurichi DHS Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: The Staff Nurse gets a consolidated pay of Rs. 21,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Kallakurichi DHS Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Download the form from https://kallakurichi.nic.in/ and attach the document copies. Then submit it in person (10.00 AM to 5.00 PM) or send it by speed post to the Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Office, Peruvangur Road, Kallakurichi 606 213.

faq.question: Q7. How will Kallakurichi DHS select Staff Nurses?
faq.answer: The District Health Society has the right to call suitable applicants for certificate verification / interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Kallakurichi DHS Staff Nurse job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary and on contract. Selected nurses must declare that it will not be regularised or converted into a permanent post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the minimum service period for the Kallakurichi DHS Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: Under the NHM-TN contract rules, a selected nurse must serve at least 2 years. The contract is renewed every 11 months based on a performance appraisal, and resignation needs 3 months' prior notice.

faq.question: Q10. How recent must the conduct certificate be for the Kallakurichi DHS Staff Nurse application?
faq.answer: The conduct certificate must come from a Group A or Group B government officer and must have been obtained within 3 months before the notification was published. This applies to all applicants, including fresh graduates.
